title: The Grass Fire
text: Smoke rises on the horizon in a long brown wall. The plains are burning. Animals run past you, deer, wolves and hares side by side, and the wind is bringing the fire this way faster than any of them.

options.label: Run before the fire, with the beasts, and do not look back.

outcomes.text: You stay ahead of it, gasping, with ash in your hair.
It catches you at the edge, and the grass goes up under your feet.

options.label: The cleverest lights a backfire, and fights fire with fire.

outcomes.text: It leaves a black patch to shelter in. The fire roars past on both sides, then is gone.

options.label: Make for the river, where the fire cannot follow.

outcomes.text: The river keeps the fire off. The fleeing beasts crowd round you there, frightened enough to trample anyone.
